j:translation_en.jcr:title: GraphQL Extension Websites administrator
j:translation_en.jcr:description: Grants access to the website lifecycle GraphQL mutations (create, export, import) without requiring full server administrator rights. Does NOT grant deletion or export of a specific site: to delegate either, grant the 'GraphQL Extension Websites site administrator' role on that site. To delegate a narrower subset, build a custom role from graphqlAdminMutation plus websitesCreate, websitesExportAll and the coarse websitesAdmin gate - those are the only ones safe to grant at the repository root. Never grant websitesDelete or websitesExport at the root: they are checked against the target site and JCR permissions inherit downward, so a root grant satisfies that check on every site and lets the holder delete or export any site on the instance. See 'Delegating a narrower subset' in the README.

j:translation_en.jcr:title: GraphQL Extension Websites site administrator
j:translation_en.jcr:description: Grants export and deletion of the site this role is granted on, through the exportWebsite and deleteSiteByKey GraphQL mutations. Grant it per site; the holder also needs the server-level 'GraphQL Extension Websites administrator' role to reach the API. Includes read on the site, which exportWebsite needs to produce a non-empty archive.
